sequence_description: JWT IdP: control JWT with correct issuer/time claims should be accepted; attack JWT differs only by aud (wrong audience). If accepted, broker may verify signature but not enforce semantic audience binding (proof integrity failure).
description:
Assertion FAILED: jwt_attack_login_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: jwt_attack_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT IdP accepted a token with wrong aud (signature verified but semantic audience binding not enforced).

sequence_description: JWT IdP freshness + replay window: control JWT with exp/iat accepted; attack JWT omits exp and is submitted twice via two separate idp intents. Missing exp should be rejected; if accepted, it can be replayed indefinitely.
description:
Assertion FAILED: jwt_i2_attack1_login_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: jwt_i2_attack1_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT missing exp was accepted for federated login (expiry check bypass).

sequence_description: JWT IdP freshness + replay window: control JWT with exp/iat accepted; attack JWT omits exp and is submitted twice via two separate idp intents. Missing exp should be rejected; if accepted, it can be replayed indefinitely.
description:
Assertion FAILED: jwt_i2_attack2_login_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: jwt_i2_attack2_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT missing exp was accepted again on a second intent (replayable indefinitely due to missing expiry enforcement).

sequence_description: JWT IdP: control JWT with exp+iat should be accepted; attack JWT omits iat (freshness anchor) and must be rejected. If accepted, stale tokens can be replayed indefinitely within exp window or without issuance-time constraints.
description:
Assertion FAILED: jwt_iat_attack_login_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: jwt_iat_attack_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT missing iat was accepted — freshness window can be bypassed, enabling replay of arbitrarily old tokens.

sequence_description: JWT IdP: baseline JWT with correct issuer and temporal claims is accepted, then an otherwise-valid JWT with wrong aud is submitted. If accepted, audience binding is not enforced and authorization can be granted outside upstream intent.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_jwt_wrong_aud_login_http_status >= 400 OR attack_retrieve_status >= 400
Evaluation: (user_attacker_jwt_wrong_aud_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False) OR (attack_retrieve_status=200 >= 400 → False)
Implication: JWT with wrong aud was accepted, indicating missing audience binding and potential authorization beyond UpstreamIntent ∩ BrokerPolicy.
